---
title: "ibm_verify_events_transformed.events_mfa_activity"
description: "Daily multi-factor authentication activity by factor and result."
---

Daily multi-factor authentication (MFA) activity, broken down by factor and
outcome.

Each row is the count of MFA events for one day, factor, and result.

`Keywords`: MFA, multi-factor, second factor, OTP, FIDO2, authentication, security

## Provenance

Built from [`mfa_activity`](../ibm_verify_events_raw/mfa_activity.qmd) by
`compute_mfa_activity()` in the [daily metrics
job](https://github.com/cds-snc/canadalogin-reporting-data-pipeline/blob/main/infra/modules/ibm_verify_events_streaming/glue_src/ibm_verify_events_metrics_daily.py).
The job maps the raw factor names (for example "SMS OTP") to the `mfa_type`
values below.

* **Updated**: Daily, at 04:00 ET, for the previous ET day
* **Retention**: While CanadaLogin exists
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca)
* **Location**: `s3://<transformed-bucket>/ibm_verify_metrics/events_mfa_activity/`

## Fields

One row per day per `mfa_type` per `result`.

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| from_date | string | The reporting day in ET, for example "2026-09-15". Cast before comparing to a date |
| to_date | string | Same as `from_date` |
| mfa_type | string | The factor used. One of "sms_otp", "email_otp", "voice_otp", "fido2", "totp", "qr", "kq", or "ibm_verify_push" |
| result | string | "sent", "success", or "failure" |
| count | bigint | Number of MFA events for this day, factor, and result |
| fetched_at | string | When the job wrote the row, in ISO 8601 UTC |
| date | string | Partition key. Same as `from_date` |

## Notes

**OTP factors log a "sent" event too.** `sms_otp`, `email_otp`, and `voice_otp`
log "sent" when the code goes out, then "success" or "failure" for each attempt.
A mistyped code followed by the right one gives one "sent", one "failure", and
one "success". `fido2` logs only "success" or "failure".

- For success rates, divide "success" by "success" plus "failure", and exclude "sent".
- For usage, count "sent" for OTP factors and "success" plus "failure" for the others. Summing "sent" alone drops `fido2`.

**Most `email_otp` is sign-up, not sign-in.** The email check during sign-up
logs an `email_otp` with no user, because the account does not exist yet. These
are most `email_otp` "sent" events. The rest carry a user, and are most likely
the same check when an existing user changes their email address. See
[`mfa_activity`](../ibm_verify_events_raw/mfa_activity.qmd) in the raw stream.
